what.text: This page follows refugees from the Niger living in Nigeria, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 12215 Nigerien refugees in Nigeria, 14.3% of all refugees from the Niger.
Mali hosts the most Nigerien refugees, followed by Nigeria, Benin and Chad.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict with the Islamic State group in the Niger from 2015 to 2025.
It also records armed conflict over the government of the Niger with JNIM from 2021 to 2025.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 2018 at 6 refugees.
The figure reached its highest point, 14965, at the end of 2024, and the main years of displacement in the data are 2024 and 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Nigeria.
These are year-end totals for Nigeria only, reported to UNHCR.
